sections.description: The Shorthand plugin allows you to publish Shorthand stories directly to your WordPress site.
sections.changelog:
1.0.7

  • Render site headers and footers for Shorthand stories using block themes
  • Fix story permalinks returning 404 after activation or a permalink change

1.0.6

  • Allow editors to recover Shorthand stories that are not attached

1.0.5

  • Fix settings save disconnecting the plugin

1.0.4

  • Confirm compatibility with WordPress 6.9.4
  • Fix story permalink slug falling back to the post type name

1.0.3

  • Improve error messaging when connections to Shorthand fail
  • Extend authorisation token expiry to tolerate slower navigation
